findings.title: Recorded ISRCTN identifier omitted from Registry column
findings.why: The Registry cell implies no recorded identifier, although this trial's row contains ISRCTN55906981. The earlier family_id omission remains present for non-NCT registrations.
findings.fix: Render recorded ISRCTN identifiers from family_id in the Registry column, linking to the appropriate registry.
